title: SessionMetrics
description: Aggregated performance metrics for a recording session

totalQueries.description: Total number of queries in the session

totalDuration.description: Total execution time of all queries in milliseconds

averageDuration.description: Average query execution time in milliseconds

maxDuration.description: Maximum single query execution time in milliseconds

minDuration.description: Minimum single query execution time in milliseconds

queryTypeDistribution.description: Count of queries by operation type

modelDistribution.description: Count of queries by model name

slowestQueries.description: Top 10 slowest queries by execution duration
